 Caitlin Clark Gifts Jimmy Fallon the Taylor Swift-Inspired Nike Caitlin 1 Friendship Bracelet
 Nicholas Vlahos Published November 7, 2026 at 2:32 PM Add to Google News Quick Facts
 During Caitlin Clark's appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, she gifted Jimmy a pair of the Taylor Swift-inspired Caitlin 1 Friendship Bracelet
 Clark revealed the sneaker will come with customizable charms so you can display your own message on the shoe
 The Nike Caitlin 1 Friendship Bracelet will release late February 2027
 This content may contain affiliate links. If you make a purchase through these links, we may earn a commission.
 The WNBA season may be over, but it’s still Caitlin Clark season over at Nike . The Swoosh finally launched Clark’s first signature sneaker, the Nike Caitlin 1 , in October, and has plans to roll out plenty more renditions of CC’s shoe over the coming months. Of course, we can’t talk about Clark without her connection to arguably one of the biggest superstars on planet Earth, Taylor Swift. Caitlin has already previewed a special colorway of the Caitlin 1 modeled after the friendship bracelets that T-Swift popularized during her Eras Tour, and while the public will have to wait for a chance to secure the sneaker, The Tonight Show host Jimmy Fallon received his own pair last night.
 Caitlin Clark’s Gift to Jimmy Fallon
 During Caitlin’s appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, the Indiana Fever superstar promoted her new children's book, EXTRAordinary , and told some hilarious stories before Fallon brought up her Nike signature sneaker. Clark then surprised Fallon with his very own pair of the Friendship Bracelet colorway, telling the audience that, until that point, she was the only person in the world with the pair. She also revealed that the shoe will come with charms that you can customize to your liking, with the pair that Fallon received featuring “2NITE SHOW” on the lace dubrae.
 Caitlin Clark’s Taylor Swift Fandom
 Outside of Caitlin Clark’s love for Taylor Swift’s music, the two are both fans of the Kansas City Chiefs. Clark grew up a Chiefs fan , and Swift is married to KC’s TE1 Travis Kelce, and they have shared VIP suites together to catch the squad in action. Caitlin also made mention that fans bring her bracelets at WNBA games, so when these do hit shelves, it’ll be great to see Caitlin and Taylor fans have something else that can connect the two superstars.
 When Does the Nike Caitlin 1 Friendship Bracelet Release?
 Caitlin Clark revealed that the Nike Caitlin 1 Friendship Bracelet will be released in late February 2027. Expect the pair to be available via Nike and select retailers online and in-store. The retail price isn’t confirmed just yet, but most pairs of the Caitlin 1 retail for $140, so it should hover around that price point.
